name: sandbox-mode
description: Sandbox mode: a site built from biome/difficulty/seed starts from nothing, honours the seed, and is fully playable through to a blast (#504: 3-control setup).

steps.command: sandbox start biome:alpine_granite difficulty:hard seed:777 staffed:true
steps.description: No new_game first — a sandbox site is created from nothing, which is the point of the mode. #553: staffed:true (sandbox start supports the same flag as new_game, Sandbox.ts) hires a driller with blasting + drill_rig licence and buys an unmanned drill_rig for free — automatic drill dispatch needs both to ever land an ordered hole.

interaction.command: sandbox start biome:alpine_granite difficulty:hard seed:777 staffed:true

steps.description: Biome and seed should match what was asked for. Grid extents are the fixed 64x32x64 default regardless of request (#504).

steps.command: drill_plan grid rows:2 cols:2 spacing:4 depth:6 start:15,20
steps.description: #553: shrunk from the original rows:3 cols:3 (9 holes, start:20,20) to 2x2 (4 holes) so the single driller/drill_rig lands the whole plan quickly -- this file's point is a full drill/charge/blast cycle actually working, not a specific hole count. #1151: moved from start:10,10 to start:14,17 for climb-reachability. #1263: moved again, from start:14,17 to start:15,20, after the CREW_SPAWN_AGENT_SEPARATION fix (this same issue) changed where the staffed roster's own five employees and four vehicles land under this seed -- one of them (the blaster) now spawns exactly on (14,17) itself, so a drill_rig sent to drill H1 there was blocked by an employee standing on its own destination cell forever (orderedHoleCount stuck at 1). start:15,20's four holes -- (15,20) (19,20) (15,24) (19,24) -- collide with no employee or vehicle spawn cell. Confirmed via a direct 6000-tick trace: all four land by tick 45 (this step's own max_ticks keeps its existing 600-tick headroom).

#553: drain the ordered plan -- the staffed driller/drill_rig lands all 4 holes. #1151: was a hand-measured `tick 60` pad, replaced with a waitUntil on the thing actually being waited for, per dev-scenario-authoring -- a stall now fails loudly and by name instead of silently handing the next step an undrilled plan. #1263: start:15,20's plan (see the step above) lands all 4 holes at tick 45, measured via a direct trace -- max_ticks:600 keeps ample headroom over that.

expect.note: All 4 holes have landed -- none lost, none left ordered forever.

steps.description: #554: drain the charge order(s) queued by the step above (charging is real work, not instant) before continuing. #1263: this used to stall here forever (never reaching 0) regardless of the drill plan's own coordinates -- every charge target beyond the crew's immediate spawn cluster required a foot leg through a single climb-legal corridor cell a spawned-but-never-dispatched vehicle permanently occupied, and the per-hop ground-cell occupancy check (AgentAdvance.ts) had no exemption for a foot leg already planned to cross vehicle-occupied ground. Fixed at the source (AgentAdvance.ts/Locomotion.ts/PlanItinerary.ts), not by picking yet another coordinate -- every foot destination beyond that corridor hit the identical stall. With the fix, start:15,20's four charges land by tick 30, measured via a direct trace; max_ticks:3000 keeps ample headroom.
A second site with a different biome, difficulty and seed, to confirm the mode can be re-entered.

expect.note: difficulty:easy starts at $250,000 (SANDBOX_DIFFICULTIES.easy.startingCash, Sandbox.ts) -- grid extents stay the fixed 64x32x64 default (#504) regardless of biome/difficulty, same as the first site.
